summary: You can now pin traps, bait, charms, potions, and recipes to the top menu, alongside the convertibles and message items you could already pin. Set them up under Personalization → Custom Menu. Happy hunting!

details.title: New
items: Custom Menu: Pin traps, bait, charms, potions, and recipes to the top menu

Location HUDs - Floating Islands: The Sky Map now warns you when you choose an island without a Warden or Paragon, or one where the shrine isn't the first tile. There are also new indicators for the Wardens and Paragons on your map
Better Maps: Invite hunters by clicking the empty slots on maps you own
Better Marketplace: Click item names in your listings and history to open them

details.title: Fixed and Updated
items: Better Inventory: Tidier sort and filter controls, and category menus that stay visible while scrolling
Data Exporters: More reliable CSV exports
Better Journal and Dark Mode: Style tweaks
